name: Two Fires
summary: The main story (docs/main_story.md): 1757-1775, one character from a homestead in the open land, through captivity and adoption, the burning of the town, the line and the tax, to the eve of the Revolution. Built so far: the Prologue (Open Land) on the valley map.

start._doc: How a new game of this storyline starts: the survival core's start (SurvivalCore.new_game options) and where the player stands.

places._doc: Named points on the map, [x, z] in metres (the valley: the fort's square, +-416 m). The stockade stands in for the fort at German Flatts in 1757 (H: Fort Herkimer, the stone house fortified in 1756; verify). The homestead plot is in the woods south-east of it: the player clears it.
